multi_entity_note: Phoenix Satellite Television Company Limited (Party A) and Beijing Tianying Jiuzhou Network Technology Co., Ltd. (Party B), plus other referenced entities.
processing_note: Any and all notices, approvals, requests, authorizations, instructions or other communications required hereunder (collectively, "Written  Documents") shall be made in writing and with a reference to this Agreement.

contract.document_name.rationale: The cover and preamble name it Program Content License Agreement.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: The agreement is entered into on November 24, 2009 per cover and preamble; c3 dates a different agreement and 4/21/2011 is the filing footer.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Article 9.1 makes it effective on the date of signing and sealing, an event rather than a stated date.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The term is five years from the effective date; no expiration date is stated.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Article 11.1 says the agreement is governed by the PRC Law; other mentions are incorporation, definition, or arbitration venue.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Article 9.2 allows extension for a negotiated length only; no renewal term length is stated.

contract.notice_period.rationale: No notice period to prevent renewal is stated.
